A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CoSMo study and contain readable text, equations, algorithms, figures, tables and complete appendices. Existing material can be matched despite appendix renumbering and layout changes.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, SFT/RL ablations, reasoning-depth analyses and comparisons across LLM judges in Figures 1–5 and Tables 1–5.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results in the main text and Appendix C. Their retention from v1 does not change their status as original empirical results.

M1.justification: Sections 4.1–4.3, Algorithm 1 and the prompt templates retain the same split-merge curation, supervised fine-tuning, GRPO procedure and reward components. The added related-work discussion introduces no method component.

E1.justification: Both versions use HotpotQA and HaluEval as ID benchmarks, NQ and CRAG for OOD evaluation, and MuSiQue for reasoning-depth analyses. The new discussion of vision-language-action models and chip placement adds no evaluated datasets or tasks.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain CoT, ToT, HTP, CoD, TALE, C3oT, FS-BoN, SPIRIT, LCPO and ThinkPrune. Comparator membership also remains unchanged within the ablation and robustness experiments; the newly cited works are not evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix A preserve the backbones, ID/OOD design, accuracy/token/segment metrics, training settings, structured prompting and LLM-judge procedures. No existing protocol is revised or new evaluation protocol introduced.

E4.justification: The segment-count analysis, SFT/RL ablations, MuSiQue hop-complexity analysis, judge-robustness checks and split-merge case study are retained. The results and case study move from Appendices B/C to C/D without substantive changes.

E5.justification: Both versions report point estimates without experimental seed disclosures, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars or statistical significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Tables 1–5 and the plotted findings retain the same results. For example, Table 1 still reports CoSMo averages of 71.7% accuracy, 153 tokens and 2.9 segments; Table 4 retains MuSiQue accuracies of 43.2%, 41.4% and 41.1% for 2-, 3- and 4-hop questions.

T1.justification: The reasoning-structure definitions, optimization objectives in Equations 1–2, split/merge formulations and GRPO/reward mathematics are unchanged. New Appendix B provides conceptual analogies rather than formal assumptions, derivations or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same split-merge and segment-budgeting contributions and generalization claims. The claimed 3.3-point accuracy improvement and 28.7% segment reduction relative to efficient reasoning baselines are unchanged.

C2.justification: The explanations of structural redundancy, complementary SFT/RL effects, robustness and the case-study mechanism remain unchanged, as do the impact statement's qualifications. Appendix B adds research connections without revising the experimental interpretations or substantive limitations.

D1.justification: Appendix A retains the same hardware, LoRA configuration, batch sizes, learning rate, epochs, judge/generator models, iteration limit and GRPO settings. Figures 6–9 preserve the exact prompts despite Appendix D becoming E; no code or data access information is added.

R1.justification: New Appendix B adds five cited works connecting CoSMo to Evo-1, VLA-Pruner and RL-based chip/macro placement, including LaMPlace. This broadens peripheral research positioning while retaining the main text's relationships to prior reasoning methods.

P1.justification: v3 inserts 'More Related Work' as Appendix B, renumbers the existing results, case study and prompts, and updates cross-references. It also replaces the preprint footer with proceedings text and identifies the previously anonymous, same-titled faithfulness reference as Gui et al. (2026). The substantive main-text prose is otherwise retained.

P2.justification: Table 3 moves from PDF page 14 to 15, while Tables 4–5, case-study blocks and references reflow. The first-page footer and Figure 2's appendix reference change. Figure designs, axes, legends and table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 adds peripheral context in Appendix B and makes a previously anonymous citation identifiable. These small editorial gains do not materially alter the central argument's clarity or support: the method, experiments, results and reproducibility information remain unchanged. The layout adjustments likewise produce no meaningful overall quality difference.
